sentences.en: The generous dentist contributed some two billion yen to charity.
sentences.zh: 这位慷慨的牙科医生捐赠了两百亿日元用于慈善。

sentences.en: I'm such a coward that I rarely visit the dentist.
sentences.zh: 我太怕疼了，很少去看牙医。

sentences.en: I hope I will become a dentist in the future.
sentences.zh: 我希望将来能成为一名牙医。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：dent（牙齿）+ist（从事某职业的人）→牙医
